package.name: rp1_compass
package.description: IST8310 magnetometer driver over I2C -- the compass bundled on the GPS module's own breakout board (Dalang DL25F10NQ, NEO-F10N + IST8310), physically distinct from the ICM20948's internal AK09916 magnetometer handled by rp1_imu. Unverified against real hardware -- see ist8310_driver_node.py's module docstring.
